facts.fact: GPE KIX says Eswatini's fully digital, PIN-driven EMIS, nationally launched in March 2024, covers all 976 primary and secondary schools and provides aggregate enrolment numbers.
GPE KIX says Eswatini's PIN-driven EMIS introduced individual-level student and staff tracking across all 976 schools.

SWZ.note: No linked fact: learner PINs are validated against Home Affairs records by hand on claim forms.

facts.fact: GPE KIX says The Gambia's Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education is integrating individual-level learner and teacher data and has SEMIS pilots.

systems.owner: Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education

facts.fact: GPE KIX says Sierra Leone is integrating multiple data systems into a national warehouse and developing a learner-centered EMIS, with a newly drafted EMIS policy and a digital Master Schools List.
